requests.title: Defective Streetlight Cluster along Hospital Road
requests.landmark: Near Murang'a Level 5 Hospital Main Gate
requests.description: Four consecutive streetlights have been flickering and completely shut down for the past 6 nights, posing security risks for healthcare staff and patients entering the hospital after dark.
requests.resolutionNotes: Field electrical team dispatched on Oct 16 to inspect the underground cable junction. Transformer breaker tripped due to stormwater ingress.

timeline.title: Service Request Submitted
timeline.description: Request successfully logged via Murang'a eCitizen portal.

timeline.title: Assigned to Energy Maintenance Unit
timeline.description: Forwarded by County Service Desk to Eng. Peter Gitau. Work order #WO-884 issued.

requests.title: Severe Water Pipe Burst at Kangari Tea Center
requests.landmark: Opposite Kangari Market, near KTDA Factory
requests.description: Main 4-inch supply line ruptured under the feeder road. Clean potable water is gushing into tea collection bays, leaving over 120 households without tap water.
requests.assignedDepartment: Water, Irrigation, Environment and Natural Resources
requests.resolutionNotes: MUWASCO technical unit replaced the 4-meter fractured PVC section with ductile iron pipeline. Water pressure fully restored.
requests.feedbackComment: Thank you Murang'a County Government and Governor Kang'ata for rapid response. Water restored within 24 hours!

timeline.title: Request Logged
timeline.description: Urgent water burst reported by resident.

timeline.title: MUWASCO Rapid Response Team Dispatched
timeline.description: Excavation team on site with pipe fittings.

timeline.title: Repairs Completed and Flow Restored
timeline.description: New coupling fitted and leak tested. Pressure normalized.

requests.title: Culvert Blockage & Pothole Washout on Maragua-Gakoigo Road
requests.description: Recent rains have blocked the main stormwater culvert, causing heavy water runoff to carve out a 2-foot deep pothole directly in the driving lane.

timeline.title: Request Received
timeline.description: Awaiting initial triage by County Roads & Infrastructure Directorate.

requests.title: Illegal Plastic Waste Dumping on Chania Riverbank
requests.description: Unidentified commercial trucks are dumping construction debris and plastic waste directly onto the Chania river tributary at night.
requests.assignedDepartment: Water, Irrigation, Environment and Natural Resources
requests.resolutionNotes: County enforcement officers cordoned off the access path and impounded one non-compliant truck.

timeline.title: Enforcement Enforcement Intervened
timeline.description: County Compliance unit deployed to investigate and block illegal entry.

requests.title: Kang'ataCare Medication Stock Verification at Kiru Health Center
requests.description: Essential hypertension and diabetes drugs under the subsidized Kang'ataCare program were temporarily depleted. Requesting delivery of fresh consignment.
requests.resolutionNotes: Central medical stores dispatched emergency stock batch #KMC-449 to Kiru Dispensary on Oct 17. Medication now available for all registered beneficiaries.
requests.feedbackComment: Confirmed receipt at the dispensary. Very efficient service.

timeline.title: Request Logged
timeline.description: Medication stock alert received from local patient committee.

timeline.title: Stock Requisition Approved
timeline.description: County Pharmacist authorized emergency batch distribution.

timeline.title: Pharmaceuticals Delivered & Restocked
timeline.description: Dispensary staff logged full stock receipt.
